text:
lucy: Quick heads-up — noticed two docs/snippet problems in quickstart that led to customer confusion today. Short summary: bash script breaks on Windows (CRLF), curl example logs the raw bearer token when people paste it into shell history, and the Node sample shows naive retry loop with no jitter.

omar: yikes. Which README file is this? I can patch.

lucy: docs/quickstart/README.md. Repro: customer copied the bash snippet into a file on Windows, scp'd to linux, got '/bin/bash^M: bad interpreter'. Also some users copy the curl line directly into their terminal which leaves the token in bash_history. Example we have: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
That line is fine but we should suggest the safer pattern: `curl -X POST ... -H "Authorization: Bearer $(printf \"%s\" \"$REDWOOD_KEY\")"`? hmm. maybe better: read token from stdin or env and show PS example.

rachel: for curl I'd rather suggest: `curl -X POST ... -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" --netrc-file ~/.netrc` no wait, netrc is for basic auth only. Another simple suggestion: encourage `export REDWOOD_KEY=...` then paste only the command without the token. Or show placeholder `Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>` and call out not to paste real tokens in public chats.

omar: +1 on placeholder. Also to avoid shell history leakage recommend `read -s REDWOOD_KEY` snippet in the README for interactive sessions. Small code sample: 
```bash
read -s REDWOOD_KEY
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d @payload.json
```
That keeps secrets out of history.

lucy: nice. For the Windows CRLF we should change shebang to `#!/usr/bin/env bash` and add a short note under the bash snippet: "Windows users: use the PowerShell snippet below or run `dos2unix` on saved scripts."

rachel: about retries — our Node quickstart shows a naive while loop that retries instantly. Customers who copied it hit 429 flapping. We should add exponential backoff + jitter and point to our SDK's built-in retry config. Example one-liner to add: `await sleep(Math.pow(2, attempt) * 100 + Math.random() * 100)` and a note: "Prefer SDK retry settings over DIY loops."

doc-bot: docs linting tip — ensure code fences specify language (```bash, ```powershell, ```javascript) so GH raw view preserves shebang line.

lucy: I'll open a PR that: 1) replaces shebang, 2) adds read -s example, 3) replaces inline token with <REDACTED> placeholder, 4) adds PS example, 5) updates Node sample to show backoff + recommends SDK.

devex-bot: PR checklist reminder — add changelog entry and run the docs link check job. Also add a tiny unit in CI that greps for literal 'Authorization: Bearer ' followed by alphanumerics in docs and fails to avoid accidentally committing real tokens.

omar: can you also add a short note for copy-paste from GH: use the raw button or download the file to avoid CRLF issues? Some Windows folks just copy from the rendered page.

lucy: good call. I'll include that and tag rachel for review on the retry snippet. Thanks all :thumbsup:
